summary: San Francisco Bay Area, software developer, background in industrial/organizational psychology, strong interest in Chinese language and linguistics, advocates for direct support of developers, critical of middlemen in funding, engaged in discussions about mental health and schizophrenia, interested in technology and software development (especially Linux and open-source), skeptical of traditional educational methods, explores philosophical implications of science and ethics, critical of meritocracy and societal structures, values privacy and security in technology, engaged in discussions about cognitive abilities and job performance.
